         xmlns:rdf="http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#"
         xmlns:rdfs="http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#"
         xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#"
         xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"
         xmlns:vaem="http://www.linkedmodel.org/schema/vaem#">

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Asset">
  <rdfs:comment>A physical or logical component of a water system.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Asset</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ01 asks for assets composing infrastructure</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ01: Which assets compose a water distribution infrastructure?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterDistributionInfrastructure">
  <rdfs:comment>The network of pipes and facilities distributing water.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Water Distribution Infrastructure</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ01 asks about infrastructure composition</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ01: Which assets compose a water distribution infrastructure?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Sensor">
  <rdfs:comment>A device that detects or measures a physical property.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Sensor</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 asks about sensor types</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which types of sensors are used in water infrastructures?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Device"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Device -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterInfrastructure">
  <rdfs:comment>Facilities and systems for water supply, treatment, and distribution.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Water Infrastructure</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 and CQ05 ask about devices used in infrastructure</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which types of sensors are used in water infrastructures?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Which types of actuators are used in water infrastructures?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Actuator">
  <rdfs:comment>A device that controls or moves a mechanism.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Actuator</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ05 asks about actuator types</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ05: Which types of actuators are used in water infrastructures?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Device"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Device -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterMeter">
  <rdfs:comment>A device that measures water flow and usage.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Water Meter</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06-CQ12, CQ18-CQ20, CQ38-CQ43 ask about meter attributes and relations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: A water meter is a device that measures different aspects of a water infrastructure.
    (competency_question) CQ08: What is the fabrication number of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ09: What are the manufacturer and the model of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ10: What is the version of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ11: What is the hardware version number of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ12: What firmware version is the water meter using?
    (competency_question) CQ18: What is the power of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ19: What is the radio frequency level of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ20: What is the geolocation of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ38: What is the start date and time of the tariff in use in the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ39: What is the duration of the current tariff of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ40: What is the tariff period of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ42: What is the billing date of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ43: What is the billing date period of the water meter?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Device"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Device -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Device">
  <rdfs:comment>A piece of equipment or machinery.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Device</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04-CQ06 establish device hierarchy</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which types of sensors are used in water infrastructures?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Which types of actuators are used in water infrastructures?
    (competency_question) CQ06: A water meter is a device that measures different aspects of a water infrastructure.</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Equipment"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Equipment -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Equipment">
  <rdfs:comment>The necessary items for a particular purpose.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Equipment</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 establishes device as equipment</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: A water meter is a device that measures different aspects of a water infrastructure.</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Aspect">
  <rdfs:comment>A particular part or feature of something.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Aspect</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 asks what aspects a meter measures</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: A water meter is a device that measures different aspects of a water infrastructure.</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Measurement">
  <rdfs:comment>The process or result of measuring a quantity.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Measurement</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ25 asks about measurement temporal settings</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ25: Water meters can provide measurements according to different temporal settings.</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Water">
  <rdfs:comment>The chemical substance H2O, essential for life.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Water</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ33 and CQ34 ask about water properties</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ33: What are the physical properties of water?
    (competency_question) CQ34: What are the chemical properties of water?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterIndicator">
  <rdfs:comment>A metric or parameter used to assess water quality or status.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Water Indicator</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ37 asks about indicators defined for locations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ37: Which water indicators are defined for Burgos?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Location">
  <rdfs:comment>A particular position or place.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Location</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ37 asks about indicators defined for locations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ37: Which water indicators are defined for Burgos?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Tariff">
  <rdfs:comment>A schedule of fees or rates for water usage.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Tariff</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ38 and CQ39 ask about tariff attributes</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ38: What is the start date and time of the tariff in use in the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ39: What is the duration of the current tariff of the water meter?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

  <!-- owl:ObjectProperty declarations -->

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#compose">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates an asset to the water distribution infrastructure it composes.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Compose</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ01 connects infrastructure to assets
    [OntoCorrection Agent | loop_rounds: 1 tool_retries: 1 | themis_test] swapped domain and range: Themis test CQ01 expects compose domain Asset and range WaterDistributionInfrastructure</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ01: Which assets compose a water distribution infrastructure?
    (themis_test) CQ01: compose domain Asset -> Absent; compose range WaterDistributionInfrastructure -> Absent</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Asset"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterDistributionInfrastructure"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Asset -->
  <!-- Axiom: range WaterDistributionInfrastructure -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#usedIn">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a sensor or actuator to the water infrastructure it is used in.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Used In</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 and CQ05 connect devices to infrastructure
    [OntoCorrection Agent | loop_rounds: 1 tool_retries: 1 | themis_test] updated domain to Sensor and added Actuator domain axiom: Themis tests CQ04 and CQ05 expect usedIn domain Sensor and usedIn domain Actuator</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which types of sensors are used in water infrastructures?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Which types of actuators are used in water infrastructures?
    (themis_test) CQ04: usedIn domain Sensor -> Absent; CQ05: usedIn domain Actuator -> Absent</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Sensor"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterInfrastructure"/>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Actuator"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Sensor -->
  <!-- Axiom: domain Actuator -->
  <!-- Axiom: range WaterInfrastructure -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#measure">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a water meter to the aspects it measures.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Measure</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 connects meters to measured aspects</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: A water meter is a device that measures different aspects of a water infrastructure.</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterMeter"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Aspect"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain WaterMeter -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Aspect -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#hasTariff">
  <rdfs:comment>General relation linking a water meter to a tariff.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Has Tariff</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] coined: Unifies tariff and currentTariff which share domain WaterMeter and range Tariff</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ38: What is the start date and time of the tariff in use in the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ39: What is the duration of the current tariff of the water meter?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterMeter"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Tariff"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain WaterMeter -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Tariff -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#tariff">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a water meter to the tariff currently in use.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Tariff</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ38 asks for the tariff in use</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ38: What is the start date and time of the tariff in use in the water meter?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterMeter"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Tariff"/>
  <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#hasTariff"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubPropertyOf hasTariff -->
  <!-- Axiom: domain WaterMeter -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Tariff -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#currentTariff">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a water meter to its active tariff.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Current Tariff</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ39 asks for the current tariff</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ39: What is the duration of the current tariff of the water meter?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterMeter"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Tariff"/>
  <rdfs:subPropertyOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#hasTariff"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubPropertyOf hasTariff -->
  <!-- Axiom: domain WaterMeter -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Tariff -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#definedFor">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates a water indicator to the location it applies to.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Defined For</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ37 connects indicators to locations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ37: Which water indicators are defined for Burgos?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterIndicator"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Location"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain WaterIndicator -->
  <!-- Axiom: range Location -->
</owl:ObjectProperty>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<rdf:RDF xml:base="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#"

         xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"

  <owl:Ontology rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#"/>

  <!-- owl:Class declarations -->

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Asset">

  <rdfs:label>Asset</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ01 asks for assets composing infrastructure</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ01: Which assets compose a water distribution infrastructure?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterDistributionInfrastructure">
  <rdfs:comment>The network of pipes and facilities distributing water.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Water Distribution Infrastructure</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ01 asks about infrastructure composition</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ01: Which assets compose a water distribution infrastructure?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Sensor">

  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 asks about sensor types</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which types of sensors are used in water infrastructures?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Device"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Device -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterInfrastructure">
  <rdfs:comment>Facilities and systems for water supply, treatment, and distribution.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Water Infrastructure</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ04 and CQ05 ask about devices used in infrastructure</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which types of sensors are used in water infrastructures?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Which types of actuators are used in water infrastructures?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Actuator">

    (competency_question) CQ19: What is the radio frequency level of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ20: What is the geolocation of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ38: What is the start date and time of the tariff in use in the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ39: What is the duration of the current tariff of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ40: What is the tariff period of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ42: What is the billing date of the water meter?
    (competency_question) CQ43: What is the billing date period of the water meter?</dc:source>

  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which types of sensors are used in water infrastructures?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Which types of actuators are used in water infrastructures?
    (competency_question) CQ06: A water meter is a device that measures different aspects of a water infrastructure.</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Equipment"/>

</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Equipment">

  <rdfs:label>Equipment</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ06 establishes device as equipment</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: A water meter is a device that measures different aspects of a water infrastructure.</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Aspect">

  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: A water meter is a device that measures different aspects of a water infrastructure.</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Measurement">

  <rdfs:label>Water Indicator</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ37 asks about indicators defined for locations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ37: Which water indicators are defined for Burgos?</dc:source>
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Location">
  <rdfs:comment>A particular position or place.</rdfs:comment>

  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ37 asks about indicators defined for locations</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ37: Which water indicators are defined for Burgos?</dc:source>

  <!-- owl:ObjectProperty declarations -->

<owl:ObjectProperty rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#compose">
  <rdfs:comment>Relates an asset to the water distribution infrastructure it composes.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Compose</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ01 connects infrastructure to assets
    [OntoCorrection Agent | loop_rounds: 1 tool_retries: 1 | themis_test] swapped domain and range: Themis test CQ01 expects compose domain Asset and range WaterDistributionInfrastructure</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ01: Which assets compose a water distribution infrastructure?
    (themis_test) CQ01: compose domain Asset -> Absent; compose range WaterDistributionInfrastructure -> Absent</dc:source>
  <rdfs:domain rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#Asset"/>
  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterDistributionInfrastructure"/>
  <!-- Axiom: domain Asset -->
  <!-- Axiom: range WaterDistributionInfrastructure -->

    [OntoCorrection Agent | loop_rounds: 1 tool_retries: 1 | themis_test] updated domain to Sensor and added Actuator domain axiom: Themis tests CQ04 and CQ05 expect usedIn domain Sensor and usedIn domain Actuator</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ04: Which types of sensors are used in water infrastructures?
    (competency_question) CQ05: Which types of actuators are used in water infrastructures?

  <rdfs:range rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/water#WaterInfrastructure"/>
